title: SimBench-BW trace_volume_exceeded sidecar
description: Sidecar emitted when a trace-mode run exceeds the declared trace_budget_mib for the row. Format mirrors workloads/simbench_bw/trace_budgets.toml semantics so tools/cloud/trace_budgets.py::validate_exceeded_cell_has_sidecar can enforce it. Produced only when the run was allowed to proceed into sampled mode; if the run was refused pre-execution via predicted_bytes, no sidecar is written and the exit code is trace_shape_overbudget.

allOf.description: At least one exceeded_* flag must be true — a sidecar with both false is BudgetViolationUntracked-equivalent noise.
